# Real-World Test Fixture Manifest

## Legal Basis

All PDF/HTM lease documents in this directory are sourced from:

- **SEC EDGAR** (https://www.sec.gov/edgar) — Public filings under the Securities Exchange Act.
  All EDGAR filings are public domain and freely redistributable.
- **GSA** (https://www.gsa.gov) — U.S. government standard lease forms.
  Government publications are public domain.

## Client Sets

| Set | Source | Property Type | Key CAM Features |
|-----|--------|---------------|-----------------|
| `oaks-retail` | Third Coast Bancshares 10-K (EX-10.8) | Shopping center retail | NNN, 15% admin fee, no cap, formula-based pro rata |
| `research-park-office` | Exact Sciences 10-K (EX-10.1) | Office/R&D single-tenant | 100% pro rata, capital excluded, GAAP amortization |
| `generation-net-lease` | Generation Income Properties 10-K (EX-10.1) | NNN standalone retail | Triple-net, REA-based CAM sharing (30%/10%), 10% admin fee |
| `houston-commercial` | Neurogene 10-K (EX-10.35) | Multi-tenant shopping center | 5% non-cumulative cap, 15% admin fee, 63.54% pro rata |
| `kissimmee-office` | La Rosa Holdings 10-K (EX-10.128) | Small condo office | Flat CAM rate, 0% admin fee, capital/management excluded, cash basis |
